Overview Features Compatibility Documentation FAQ

Overview

What it is. SMP Regions is a region system positioned as a WorldGuard alternative, with extra flags and resettable areas. It targets 1.8 through 1.21.11 and declares Folia support.

Who it's for. Operators of survival servers who need protection, progression, economy or moderation systems.

Compatibility. Platforms: Bukkit, Spigot, Paper. Folia support is declared in the repository. Check the details below before you deploy.

What it covers

  • ✓ Regions with flags and resets
  • ✓ Thirty-four permissions
  • ✓ WorldGuard alternative
